about.intro: Haqdaar tells you which government schemes you may get, and why. It works without internet too.
about.likely.title: Only likely results
about.likely.text: We only say "likely eligible". The government department makes the final decision. Haqdaar does not submit applications and does not promise approval.
about.sources.title: Schemes and their government websites
about.district: This version is for Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. The insurance crop list and dates are still to be confirmed.
about.privacy.title: Your information
about.privacy.phone: In the farmer part, your answers stay only on your phone. They are not sent anywhere.
about.privacy.never: We never keep Aadhaar numbers, bank account numbers, photos of papers, fingerprints or passwords.
about.privacy.operator: An operator saves details only with the farmer's consent. Each operator can see only their own farmers. Farmers can ask to delete their details at any time.
about.ai.title: Use of AI
about.ai.text: An AI tool helped build this app. AI does not decide the scheme results; rules written in the app decide them. The Hindi and English text was written with AI help and is checked by a person.
